user_query: List the top 5 departments by total sales.
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.name AS department_name,
    SUM(o.amount) AS total_sales
FROM 
    departments d
JOIN 
    orders o ON d.id = o.employee_id
GROUP BY 
    d.name
ORDER BY 
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;

user_query: Which employee has the highest average deal size?
generated_sql:
SELECT e.name AS employee_name, AVG(o.amount) AS averageDealSize
FROM employees e
JOIN orders o ON e.id = o.employee_id
GROUP BY e.id
ORDER BY averageDealSize DESC
LIMIT 1;

user_query: Show me all pending orders grouped by region.
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    u.state AS region,
    SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    users u ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'Pending'
GROUP BY 
    u.state;

user_query: Calculate the ratio of successful to failed transactions per user.
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    u.username,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successful_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_transactions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.id) AS ratio
FROM 
    users u
LEFT JOIN 
    orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY 
    u.username;

user_query: Calculate the cumulative rolling sum of order amounts partitioned by department.
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    e.department_id,
    d.name AS department_name,
    SUM(o.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY e.department_id ORDER BY o.order_date) AS rolling_sum_of_amounts
FROM 
    employees e
JOIN 
    orders o ON e.id = o.employee_id
JOIN 
    departments d ON e.department_id = d.id
ORDER BY 
    e.department_id, o.order_date;
